seasons.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
seasons.quote: Sow spring crop in February and rainy season crop in June-July.

days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
days_to_first_harvest.quote: Marketable pods are available after 45-50 days of sowing.

harvest_span_days.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
harvest_span_days.quote: Vegetable cowpea TNAU Vegetable Cowpea PKM -1 125 -130 25 (green pods)
harvest_span_days.note: Vegetable cowpea lasts 125 days in all; 125 - 45 = 80 days of picking.

spacing_row_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
spacing_row_cm.quote: Keep distance of 45 cm between rows and 15 cm between plants.

spacing_plant_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Keep distance of 45 cm between rows and 15 cm between plants.

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
water_need.quote: Irrigate the crop at 4-5 days interval in summer months and 10-12 days interval in rainy season.
water_need.note: Watering every 4-5 days in summer (10-12 in the rains) is read as 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: provided there is no problem of bad drainage
